column1: # - paper_name: Name/title of the research paper
# - min_input_views: Minimum number of input camera views required (0 = text-only, 1+ = image inputs)
# - max_input_views: Maximum number of input views the method can handle effectively
# - min_extrapolation_percent: Minimum level of extrapolation/hallucination required (0-100%, where 0 = pure interpolation)
# - max_extrapolation_percent: Maximum level of extrapolation the method performs (0-100%, where 100 = complete hallucination)
# - paper_url: Link to the research paper (typically arXiv)
# - visible: Whether to display this paper (1/true/yes = show, 0/false/no = hide)
#           Use 0 to temporarily hide papers or draft entries from display
